name: Pakistani Paya
description: Traditional Pakistani paya curry with slow-cooked beef trotters in a deeply spiced, silky gravy, served with naan and fresh ginger.
ingredients: 4 cleaned beef trotters, cut into pieces
Fresh ginger, coriander, green chilies and lemon for serving
method: Rinse the cleaned trotters thoroughly and drain.
Heat oil and brown the onions, then add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and spices.
Add the trotters and cook with the masala for 8 to 10 minutes.
Add water, cover and simmer gently until the trotters are tender and the broth becomes rich and gelatinous.
Remove excess fat from the surface if desired and simmer uncovered to adjust the gravy.
Finish with garam masala and serve with ginger, coriander, green chilies and lemon.
